release_notes: Two community-issue fixes, backend-only (no frontend files changed, no rebuild needed). Parked domains in production (issue #4): the domain's index_campaign_id — the 'Campaign to serve on the root path' setting — was honoured only by the dev router, while nginx hands '/' straight to index.php, which never read the field, so a parked domain's root answered 'Campaign not specified.'. Production now serves the domain's campaign on the root, catch_404 sends dead paths there too, a Disabled domain 404s the whole host, an explicit ?campaign_id= still wins, and the routing id stays out of the click's captured parameters. Postback key on install (issue #5): the shipped default fd12e72 is public — it lives in the open repository — so an unmodified install accepted forged conversions on /fd12e72/postback. install.sh now boots the database as www-data via cli/generate_postback_key.php and writes a random 24-character key on fresh installs, printing the finished postback URL in the install summary; a key the operator already rotated survives a re-install, and existing installs are unaffected (rotate in Settings -> Postback). Both fixes are pinned by new HTTP test suites: domain_root_campaign_test (21 checks) and the postback route suite.
